description: system architecture overview for engineering audience
goal: Create a 5-slide technical architecture overview for a distributed event-streaming platform. Slide 1: Title — 'StreamCore Architecture v2.1'. Slide 2: System components — Kafka brokers (3-node cluster), Flink job manager, Redis cache tier, Postgres sink. Slide 3: Data flow diagram description — producer → topic partitioning → consumer groups → enrichment → sink. Slide 4: Scaling approach — partition-per-region, auto-scaling at 70% consumer lag, cold standby RTO 90s. Slide 5: Observability stack — Prometheus, Grafana dashboards, alert routing via PagerDuty.
